description: clk is a Pure Data external library by Thomas Grill that provides a collection of syncable clocking and timing objects (including master/client clocks, metro, delay, tap, and sync) designed for high precision and stability in complex time-based processes and sound installations.

research.notes: clk was developed by Thomas Grill using the flext C++ layer and pd-lib-builder, and is hosted on GitHub under the grrrr organization.
